name: loop
description: A personal relationship memory system — organised by the chapters of your life
author: Subir Paul

scripts.predev: LSREG=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister; if [ "$(defaults read "$(pwd)/node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info" CFBundleIdentifier 2>/dev/null)" != 'com.loop.dev' ]; then /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleName Loop" -c "Set :CFBundleDisplayName Loop" -c "Set :CFBundleIdentifier com.loop.dev" node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist && $LSREG -u node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null || true; fi; $LSREG -f node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app; sleep 1; killall Dock
scripts.dist: npm run build && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:ipc: npm run build && wdio run wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ipc
